id: 05_Basic Electrical Engg Laboratory VTU Syllabus How to use Line Tester RPS Wire St
title: 电工工具与直流稳压电源（国内版）
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/05_Basic Electrical Engg Laboratory VTU Syllabus How to use Line Tester RPS Wire St.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/05_Basic Electrical Engg Laboratory VTU Syllabus How to use Line Tester RPS Wire St（国内版）/src.py

points.K13: 稳压电源：开关和指示灯
points.S3: 断电剥线剪线，护好眼睛
points.S4: 稳压电源：限流设好，输出别短路
points.S5: 断电接线，教师检查后通电

shots.scene: 欣欣站在工具墙前，墙上挂着螺丝刀、试电笔、钳子，旁边一台双通道直流电源，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a tool wall with screwdrivers, a voltage tester pen and pliers, next to a dual-channel DC power supply, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课认识电工工具和直流稳压电源。
overlay: 电工工具与直流稳压电源

shots.scene: 试电笔、螺丝刀、钳子、直流电源四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a voltage tester pen, a screwdriver, a pair of pliers and a DC power supply with blank displays. No people.
shots.narration: 试电笔、螺丝刀、钳子、电源。

shots.scene: 阿杰用试电笔点插座，氖泡没亮，他耸耸肩说没电
shots.prompt_en: The young male student touches a socket with a voltage tester pen; the small lamp stays dark and he shrugs.
shots.narration: 阿杰用试电笔一点，不亮，就说没电。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起钳子要去剪接线板上的线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up side cutters and reaches toward a wire on a bench panel.
shots.narration: 拿起钳子就要剪线。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，拿出另一支试电笔在已知有电的插座上试
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and tests her own tester pen on a socket known to be live; its lamp glows.
shots.narration: 小研拦住：先验笔，再断电，才能动手。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 工具用对，才真正保护你。

shots.scene: 欣欣依次指向工具和电源
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points one by one at the tools and the power supply.
shots.narration: 先讲工具，再讲稳压电源。

shots.scene: 试电笔笔尖接触插座的相线孔，氖泡发光
shots.prompt_en: A voltage tester pen tip inserted into the line hole of a socket, its small neon lamp glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 试电笔用来检查有没有电。

shots.scene: 氖泡发光打闪电符号，不发光打问号
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a glowing tester lamp with a lightning symbol, and a dark tester lamp with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 氖泡亮，说明带电。

shots.scene: 试电笔剖面：笔尖金属杆、电阻、氖泡、弹簧、尾部金属
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of a voltage tester pen showing the metal tip, a resistor, a neon lamp, a spring and the metal end cap. No people.
shots.narration: 里面有电阻、氖泡和弹簧。

shots.scene: 手指按住尾部金属，笔尖接触导体
shots.prompt_en: A hand holding a tester pen with a finger on the metal end cap while the tip touches a conductor. No people.
shots.narration: 手按尾部金属，笔尖接触导体。

shots.scene: 电流箭头从笔尖经电阻、氖泡、人体流入大地
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tiny current arrow flowing from the conductor through the resistor, the neon lamp and a person pictogram to the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 电流经电阻、氖泡和人体流入大地。

shots.scene: 电压条大部分落在电阻上
shots.prompt_en: A voltage bar divided into sections, the biggest section across the resistor icon. No people.
shots.narration: 大电阻分走大部分电压，电流极小。

shots.scene: 人体与大地之间画出电容符号
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram standing on the ground with a capacitor symbol drawn between the feet and the earth. No people.
shots.narration: 人体和大地之间的电容，也是回路一部分。

shots.scene: 几种不同样式的试电笔排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Several voltage testers of different styles in a row: a pen type, a screwdriver type and a digital type with a blank display. No people.
shots.narration: 试电笔有很多种，按需要选用。

shots.scene: 一字和十字螺丝刀，手柄是绝缘材料
shots.prompt_en: A flat-head and a cross-head screwdriver with insulated handles. No people.
shots.narration: 螺丝刀用来拧紧、松开螺钉。

shots.scene: 螺丝刀标出刀头、杆和手柄
shots.prompt_en: A screwdriver icon with its tip, shaft and handle highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 刀头卡住螺钉，转动手柄施力。

shots.scene: 老李用螺丝刀把开关面板固定在木布线板上（电源已断开）
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer screws a switch plate onto a wooden wiring practice board that is not connected to power.
shots.narration: 装布线板、接开关，都离不开它。

shots.scene: 尖嘴钳夹住导线头弯成小圈
shots.prompt_en: Needle-nose pliers gripping the end of a wire and bending it into a small loop. No people.
shots.narration: 尖嘴钳，能夹、能弯、能剪。

shots.scene: 剥线钳剥下导线绝缘皮
shots.prompt_en: A wire stripper neatly removing insulation from the end of a disconnected wire. No people.
shots.narration: 剥绝缘皮，最好用剥线钳。

shots.scene: 用尖嘴钳剥线、铜丝被夹伤的图标，打黄色问号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of needle-nose pliers stripping a wire with nicked copper strands and a yellow question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 钳子剥线容易伤到铜芯。

shots.scene: 斜口钳剪断一根铜线
shots.prompt_en: Diagonal side cutters snipping a disconnected copper wire. No people.
shots.narration: 斜口钳，专门用来剪线。

shots.scene: 铜线、黄铜线、铁丝三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of copper wire, brass wire and iron wire, each with a cut mark. No people.
shots.narration: 铜线、铁丝都能剪断。

shots.scene: 压线钳把端子压在导线头上
shots.prompt_en: A crimping tool pressing a metal terminal onto the end of a wire. No people.
shots.narration: 压线钳把端子压紧在导线上。

shots.scene: 压好的端子打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A finished crimped terminal on a wire with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 压接牢固，接头才不松不发热。

shots.section_title: 稳压电源：开关和指示灯
shots.scene: 双通道直流稳压电源面板：电源开关和指示灯
shots.prompt_en: The front panel of a dual-channel DC regulated power supply with a power switch and an indicator lamp highlighted, displays blank. No people.
shots.narration: 稳压电源：先认电源开关和指示灯。
overlay: 稳压电源：开关和指示灯

shots.section_title: 稳压电源：开关和指示灯
shots.scene: 开关拨上，指示灯亮
shots.prompt_en: The power switch flipped up and the indicator lamp lighting up. No people.
shots.narration: 开机后，指示灯亮起。

shots.scene: 面板左右两半分别高亮
shots.prompt_en: The left half and right half of the power supply panel highlighted in turn. No people.
shots.narration: 它有两个通道，可以单独使用。

shots.scene: 输出端一红一黑两个接线柱
shots.prompt_en: A red and a black output terminal on the power supply highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 输出端红色是正极，黑色是负极。

shots.scene: 小研对照电路图接红线到正极（电源未开）
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student connects a red lead to the positive terminal while the supply is switched off, checking a blank diagram.
shots.narration: 直流接线，正负极要分清。

shots.scene: 电压和电流显示切换开关
shots.prompt_en: A small selector switch between a voltage icon and a current icon on the panel. No people.
shots.narration: 显示屏可切换看电压或电流。

shots.scene: 粗调和细调两个电压旋钮
shots.prompt_en: Two voltage knobs on the panel, one large for coarse and one small for fine adjustment. No people.
shots.narration: 粗调、细调旋钮配合设电压。

shots.scene: 限流旋钮被高亮，旁边是盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The current limit knob highlighted with a shield icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 限流旋钮，设定输出电流的上限。

shots.scene: 数字显示屏和底部空白铭牌
shots.prompt_en: The digital display and a blank nameplate at the bottom of the power supply. No people.
shots.narration: 看显示屏读数，看铭牌的输出范围。

shots.scene: 稳压电源接到一个直流电阻电路板上
shots.prompt_en: The power supply connected to a DC resistor network board on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 做直流电路实验，就用它供电。

shots.scene: 工具和电源图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The tool icons and the power supply icon light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 这些工具，各专业都用得上。

shots.scene: 小研先在确认有电的插座上试，氖泡亮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student first tests her tester pen on a socket known to be live; the lamp glows.
shots.narration: 用前先在有电处试，确认笔是好的。

shots.scene: 氖泡不亮的试电笔旁打黄色问号
shots.prompt_en: A tester pen with a dark lamp next to a yellow question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 不亮不一定没电，笔坏了也不亮。

shots.scene: 手指碰笔尖金属杆的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a finger touching the metal tip of a tester pen, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手只按尾部，绝不碰笔尖金属。

shots.scene: 试电笔当螺丝刀用力拧的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a screwdriver-type tester pen forcing a tight screw, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 试电笔不当螺丝刀使劲拧。

shots.scene: 老李检查螺丝刀和钳子的绝缘手柄
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the insulated handles of screwdrivers and pliers.
shots.narration: 工具的绝缘手柄，用前先查。

shots.scene: 手柄开裂的钳子被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Pliers with cracked handle insulation, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手柄裂了、破了，就不能再用。

shots.scene: 绝缘手柄加断电开关，等号指向绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon equation: an insulated handle plus a switched-off power switch equals a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 绝缘工具也不能代替断电。

shots.section_title: 断电剥线剪线，护好眼睛
shots.scene: 阿杰先拉下电源开关，再拿起剥线钳
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the bench power before picking up a wire stripper.
shots.narration: 剥线、剪线之前，先断电。
overlay: 断电剥线剪线，护好眼睛

shots.section_title: 断电剥线剪线，护好眼睛
shots.scene: 阿杰戴护目镜，剪线时线头朝下
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears safety glasses and points the wire end downward as he cuts it.
shots.narration: 戴护目镜，线头朝下，防止弹飞。

shots.section_title: 断电剥线剪线，护好眼睛
shots.scene: 剪下的线头放进小收集盒
shots.prompt_en: Cut wire ends dropped into a small collection box on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 剪下的线头，随手收好。

shots.section_title: 稳压电源：限流设好，输出别短路
shots.scene: 限流旋钮转到合适位置打绿勾，转到最大打黄色问号
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a current limit knob set to a moderate position with a green check, and one turned fully up with a yellow question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 限流值按实验要求设，不是越大越好。
overlay: 稳压电源：限流设好，输出别短路

shots.section_title: 稳压电源：限流设好，输出别短路
shots.scene: 空载先调好电压，再接负载
shots.prompt_en: Icons in order: power supply with no load and a voltage display, then a load being connected. No people.
shots.narration: 先空载调好电压，断电后再接负载。

shots.section_title: 稳压电源：限流设好，输出别短路
shots.scene: 红黑输出端被导线直接连起来，冒火花，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the red and black outputs joined directly by a wire with sparks, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 输出端不能短路。

shots.section_title: 稳压电源：限流设好，输出别短路
shots.scene: 正负极接反的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the red lead going to a negative mark on a circuit, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 正负极也不能接反。

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 阿杰关闭电源后连接电路
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the bench and the DC supply before wiring the circuit board.
shots.narration: 接线、改线、拆线，一律先断电。
overlay: 断电接线，教师检查后通电

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 王老师检查接线、极性和限流设定
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the wiring, the polarity and the current limit setting against a blank diagram.
shots.narration: 请老师查接线、极性和限流。

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 王老师点头，阿杰开机
shots.prompt_en: After the safety administrator nods, the young male student switches on the supply.
shots.narration: 老师同意了，才能开机通电。

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 通电时伸手改线的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand moving a wire on a powered board, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不带电改线，有问题先断电。

shots.scene: 阿杰触电倒在台边，小研冲去拉下总闸
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slumps beside the bench after an electric shock; the female graduate student rushes to pull the main switch.
shots.narration: 有人触电，先断电，不徒手拉人。

shots.scene: 老周打电话，老李在旁照护
shots.prompt_en: The older man calls on a mobile phone with a blank screen while the facility engineer, trained in first aid, attends to the young male student.
shots.narration: 拨打 120，受过培训的人施救。

shots.scene: 电路板冒烟，老李拉闸后用二氧化碳灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A circuit board starts smoking; the facility engineer switches off the power and uses a carbon dioxide extinguisher.
shots.narration: 电气起火，先断电，不用水浇。

shots.scene: 火势变大，众人撤离，保卫处值班员打电话
shots.prompt_en: The fire grows; everyone leaves under an exit sign while the security officer calls on a phone.
shots.narration: 控制不住就撤离，拨打 119。

shots.scene: 小研向王老师报告，保卫处值班员记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the safety administrator while the security officer writes on a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 试电笔、螺丝刀、钳子图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a voltage tester pen, a screwdriver and three kinds of pliers. No people.
shots.narration: 试电笔查电，螺丝刀拧，钳子夹剪压。

shots.scene: 稳压电源面板，旋钮和红黑端子高亮
shots.prompt_en: The DC power supply panel with its knobs and red and black terminals highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 稳压电源：红正黑负，调压设限流。

shots.scene: 验笔、绝缘手柄、护目镜三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a glowing tester pen on a live socket, an intact insulated handle, and safety glasses. No people.
shots.narration: 先验笔，查手柄，断电剪线戴眼镜。

shots.scene: 断电开关、老师检查、灭火器三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a switched-off power switch, a teacher checking a circuit, and a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 断电接线，查过再通电，异常先断电。

shots.scene: 欣欣把工具一件件挂回工具墙，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot hangs the tools back on the tool wall one by one and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 工具用得对，安全跟着来，下次见！
